plan.title: End-to-end tests across the product, bugs fixed test-first
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: The stories prove each part; nothing yet proves a person can use the whole product in a browser. This stage adds four flows a person walks, with the real agent answering, and one rule: every bug found is a failing test before it is a fix.
plan.current: cp-08 has every story green: the domain, the agent loop on in-memory SQLite, pi-durable after a restart. `just e2e` runs three browser tests, all on the admin pages. No browser signs up, decides, or gets an answer from the agent.
discoveries: A form submitted before React hydrates posts natively; `__root.tsx` sets `<html data-hydrated>`, and `ready()` in `e2e/helpers.ts` waits for it.
Playwright matches button names as substrings, so a session titled 'Start here' matches `Start`; buttons use `exact: true`.
`agent-serve` keeps its pi-durable store in one default file; a test's agent needs its own `AGENT_STORE` or it shares yours.
Each run uses a fresh plan, `e2e-<time>`, so no plan room carries an earlier run's threads.
`e2e/playwright.config.ts` migrates, seeds and starts the app unless `:3000` already answers.
plan.endState: `just e2e` runs seven tests in a real browser, green: three admin tests and four flows, one with the real agent answering two people. Every bug fixed here has a test that failed first.
notDoing: A real model in tests; the faux model is deterministic and free.
Screenshot comparisons; small visual issues go through Agentation notes.
Running `just e2e` in CI; it stays a local recipe for now.
`kill -9` in a browser test; `brain.test.ts` covers the restart.
plan.approach: Helpers first, because every flow waits on them. Then the agent process the flows share. Then the four flows. Bugs met on the way follow the rule.

decisions.question: Fake the agent in end-to-end tests, or run the real process?

options.label: Fake the agent in the test

decisions.why: The real `agent-serve` with the faux model puts the whole path under test: API, plan room, socket, the agent's sign-in, pi-durable. It stays offline and gives the same answer every run.

The agent finishes the Run with the answer.
Both browsers show the same answer.
